length_protocol_amendment.reason: All three candidates had severe length censoring at 1024 tokens. The completion profile was changed only after prompt ranking, using the pinned Qwen3.5 non-thinking general sampling profile and a 4096-token cap.
length_protocol_amendment.interpretation: The residual 2B truncation tail is reported rather than gated: 11 of 12 truncated responses were incorrect and none contained a boxed answer before truncation. It represents hard-problem failure at the feasible context cap, not clipped correct answers.

selection_reason: current_zero_shot had the highest full-split mean accuracy, met the parse and teacher-minus-student-gap criteria, and retained a substantial paired capability gap. Truncation is a headline diagnostic under the recorded protocol amendment.
lookahead_prohibition: The prompt was selected before evaluating any new prompt-ICL, SFT, or steering teacher or student result.
